$description: Component tokens: component-specific values. Reference semantic tokens (primitive where no semantic role exists). Raw values only where the style guide specifies a component-specific measurement.

font-family.$description: Button label font family. Buttons do not inherit it, so it is set explicitly.

icon-size.$description: Style guide icon button note: line icon size (stroke follows currentColor).

icon-gap.$description: Style guide icon button note: gap between icon and label. Not on the spacing scale.

padding-icon-side.$description: Style guide icon button note: padding on the icon side.

padding-text-side.$description: Style guide Button page: padding on the text side of a medium button.

pressed-scale.$description: Style guide: scale applied while pressed.

pressed-duration.$description: Style guide Button page: duration of colour and press transitions.

pressed-easing.$description: Style guide Button page: easing of colour and press transitions.

border.$description: Filled variants keep a transparent border so every variant has the same edge.

bg-hover.$description: Style guide hover state fill for the primary button.
Style guide Button page: hover and pressed fill of the secondary button.

border.$description: Filled variants keep a transparent border so every variant has the same edge.

bg-hover.$description: Solid danger button hover and pressed fill.

min-width.$description: Style guide Button page: minimum width of a text button.

border-width.$description: Style guide Button page: border width. Filled variants keep a transparent border so every variant has the same edge.

focus-outline-width.$description: Style guide Button page: keyboard focus outline width.

focus-outline-offset.$description: Style guide Button page: gap between the control and its focus outline.

focus-outline-color-danger.$description: Keyboard focus outline colour on danger variants.

live-ring-width.$description: Style guide Button page: width of the ring on a running, ongoing-state button.

live-ring-color.$description: Ring colour on a running, ongoing-state button.

spinner-width.$description: Style guide Button page: stroke width of the loading spinner.

spinner-duration.$description: Style guide Button page: time for one spinner turn.

height.$description: Style guide Button page: height of the small button.

icon-size.$description: Style guide Button page: icon size in the small button.

icon-gap.$description: Style guide Button page: gap between icon and label in the small button.

padding-text-side.$description: Padding on the text side of the small button.

padding-icon-side.$description: Padding on the icon side of the small button.

font-size.$description: Label size of the small button.

height.$description: Style guide Button page: height of the large button.

icon-size.$description: Style guide Button page: icon size in the large button.

icon-gap.$description: Style guide Button page: gap between icon and label in the large button.

padding-text-side.$description: Padding on the text side of the large button.

padding-icon-side.$description: Padding on the icon side of the large button.

font-size.$description: Label size of the large button.

bg-hover.$description: Ghost button hover and pressed fill.

text.$description: Link button label. Hover adds an underline.

bg-hover.$description: Quiet danger button hover and pressed fill.

bg.$description: Fill of a toggle button that is switched on.

text.$description: Label of a toggle button that is switched on.

border.$description: Border of a toggle button that is switched on.

bg.$description: Style guide Button page: fill of an unavailable button.

radius.$description: Question strip cell corner radius. Decided: follows the documented chip and cell radius.

padding-x.$description: Side padding at the widest layout.

padding-x-md.$description: Side padding at the middle layout.

padding-x-sm.$description: Side padding at the narrow layout.

shadow-scrolled.$description: Shadow once the page scrolls under the bar. The PDF names a small shadow without a value; this is the style guide resting-surface shadow.

z-index.$description: Stacking order from the PDF. The style guide layers table uses different numbers; unresolved.

logo-gap.$description: Space after the wordmark, from the Paper design. The PDF text says less.

item-gap.$description: Gap between nav items, from the Paper design. The PDF text says less.

item-padding-x.$description: Nav item padding on every side, from the Paper design. The PDF text says a wider side padding.

item-radius.$description: Nav item corner radius. The PDF says medium radius, which the style guide sizes differently from this repo; mapped to the control radius.

item-font-size.$description: Nav item label size, semibold as in the Paper design.

item-font-weight.$description: Nav item label weight, semibold as in the Paper design. The PDF text says bold.

font-family.$description: Set explicitly because buttons and links do not always inherit it.

item-bg-hover.$description: Nav item hover and pressed background.

item-current-text.$description: Current page label colour, the action colour as in the Paper design.

easing.$description: Not given in the PDF; the same easing as the Button component.

menu-radius.$description: Menu corner radius. The style guide large radius does not exist in this repo; mapped to the tile radius.

menu-offset.$description: Gap between the trigger and its menu (PDF spec).

menu-shadow.$description: Menu shadow, from the Paper design export. Replaces the style guide value.

menu-min-width.$description: Narrowest menu width, observed from the drawing.

selector-height.$description: Context selector height, same as the icon buttons.

selector-max-width.$description: Selector width where long values truncate (PDF spec).

selector-padding-x.$description: Selector horizontal padding, from the Paper design.

selector-gap.$description: Gap between pin, value and chevron, observed from the drawing.

selector-icon-size.$description: Pin and chevron size, observed from the drawing.

selector-font-size.$description: Selector value size, small as in the Paper design. The PDF token table says larger.

utilities-gap.$description: Gap between the selector, the icon button group and the avatar, from the Paper design.

icon-size.$description: Icon size in the top bar, from the Paper design.

badge-size.$description: Count badge minimum size, measured from the drawing.

badge-bg.$description: Count badge fill, blue as drawn. The PDF token list says error red; the drawings win.

badge-font-size.$description: Count badge number size, from the Paper design.

avatar-size.$description: Avatar outer circle, from the Paper design. The PDF text says smaller.

avatar-bg.$description: Initials avatar background (PDF token table: accent subtle).

avatar-text.$description: Initials colour, from the Paper design.

avatar-font-weight.$description: Initials weight, bold, from the Paper design.

avatar-ring-open.$description: Avatar ring while the account menu is open.

selector-border-hover.$description: Selector outline on hover (PDF token table).

selector-icon-color.$description: Selector pin and chevron colour (PDF token table: secondary text).

item-inner-gap.$description: Gap between the More label and its chevron, from the Paper design.

menu-padding.$description: Padding inside menus. Not specified anywhere; a menu detail.

selector-pin-size.$description: Pin icon size, from the Paper design.

icon-gap.$description: Gap between the icon buttons, from the Paper design.

badge-offset.$description: Badge offset from the icon button corner, from the Paper design.

avatar-border.$description: Thin ring around the avatar, from the Paper design.

avatar-inner-size.$description: Photo or initials circle inside the ring, from the Paper design.

menu-item-padding-x.$description: Menu item horizontal padding, from the Paper design.

menu-item-font-size.$description: Menu item text size, from the Paper design.

menu-item-selected-bg.$description: Background of the ticked menu item.

menu-item-selected-weight.$description: Weight of the ticked menu item, bold.

menu-caption-padding.$description: Padding of the small caption above a menu list, from the Paper design.

menu-caption-letter-spacing.$description: Letter spacing of the menu caption, from the Paper design.

avatar-ring-gap.$description: Inner ring of the open avatar, white.

icon-button-focus-offset.$description: Icon button focus ring sits on the border, from the Paper design.

height-sm.$description: Small badge height, for dense rows and cards (PDF spec).

gap.$description: Space between icon and label (PDF spec).

radius.$description: Square corners mark a read-only label.

line-height.$description: Badge line height at both sizes (PDF spec).

warning-solid-text.$description: Solid warning uses dark text, not white.

gap.$description: Space between icon and label (PDF spec).

radius.$description: Square corners mark a read-only label.

line-height.$description: Tag line height at both sizes (PDF spec).

padding-x-affix.$description: Medium side padding next to a check or count (PDF spec).

padding-x-affix-sm.$description: Small side padding next to a check or count (PDF spec).

gap.$description: Space between check, label and count, medium (PDF spec).

gap-sm.$description: Space between check, label and count, small (PDF spec).

group-gap.$description: Space between chips in a set (PDF spec).

radius.$description: Fully round: the shape says this can be pressed.

disabled-border.$description: The PDF names a subtle border; the default border is the lightest one defined.

check-size.$description: Check shown when a chip is on (PDF spec).

remove-size.$description: Remove icon on an input chip (PDF spec).

remove-hit.$description: Hit area of the remove button inside the chip (PDF spec).

easing.$description: Not given in the PDF; the same easing as the Button component.

input-padding-x.$description: Side padding of an input chip, small, with an initials circle (PDF spec).

input-avatar-size.$description: Initials circle inside an input chip (PDF spec).

size.$description: Count badge next to a label or tab (PDF spec).

size-icon.$description: Count badge on an icon (PDF spec).

padding-x.$description: Side padding, so two or three digits stay inside the pill.

ring-width.$description: Ring that separates a count on an icon from the icon (PDF spec).

info-bg.$description: Blue, as drawn on the top navigation bar.

selected-bg.$description: Count fill inside a chip that is on: solid blue.

dropdown.$description: Shared floating panel for Select and Menu: panel, options, group headers, dividers, states.

panel-padding.$description: Space between the panel edge and its options.

panel-offset.$description: Gap between the trigger and the panel.

panel-max-height.$description: Tallest a panel gets before it scrolls inside.

fade-duration.$description: Panel fade in. Dropped under reduced motion.

fade-easing.$description: Not given in the PDF; the same easing as the Button component.

option-gap.$description: Space between an option's icon, text and trailing parts.

option-line-height.$description: Option line height. One pixel taller than the PDF line height.

option-font-size-sm.$description: Option text size in small selects.

option-line-height-sm.$description: Option line height in small selects.

option-active-bg.$description: The one active option, by mouse or arrow keys.

option-selected-weight.$description: Chosen option weight, so it reads without colour.

option-selected-bg.$description: Option that is both chosen and active.

option-icon-size.$description: Leading icon in menu items and the check at the end.

check-color.$description: Check mark on the chosen option.

group-letter-spacing.$description: Uppercase spacing, same as the Top navigation caption.

divider-margin.$description: Space above and below a divider.

match-bg.$description: Highlight behind the typed text inside a matching option.

shortcut-text.$description: Keyboard shortcut at the end of a menu item.

checkbox-check-color.$description: Check mark inside a checked checkbox.

message-padding.$description: Padding of the no-results and loading messages.

spinner-duration.$description: One spinner turn, same as Button.

focus-width.$description: Focus ring on triggers and the panel search field.

focus-offset.$description: Gap between the focus ring and the control.

option-padding-y.$description: Space above and below the text of a two line option, so it stays at the option height.

select.$description: Select trigger: the same box as the Text input, with a chevron.

gap.$description: Space between the icon, value and chevron.

border.$description: Trigger outline. The PDF flags the contrast of this outline as open, as for the Text input.

ring-width.$description: Extra ring while open or focused.

border-error.$description: Outline when the value is wrong.

label-gap.$description: Space between the label and the trigger.

helper-line-height.$description: Helper and error text line height.

chip-height.$description: Chosen value chip inside a multi-select trigger.

chip-gap.$description: Space between chip text and its remove button.

action-bar-padding-x.$description: Select all and Clear row padding.

action-text.$description: Clear and the action at the end.

menu.$description: Action menu: a list of commands opened from a button.

submenu-offset.$description: Gap between a menu and its submenu.

tabs.$description: Tabs: underline (large and small), card tabs, vertical list tabs and pill tabs.

font-weight.$description: Tab label weight when not selected.

font-weight-selected.$description: Tab label weight when selected, bold.

baseline-color.$description: Line under the whole tab list.

panel-gap.$description: Space from the baseline to the panel content.

fade-width.$description: Width of the edge fade when the list scrolls sideways.

focus-offset-inset.$description: Focus ring on underline tabs sits inside the tab.

focus-offset.$description: Focus ring on pill tabs sits outside the pill.

duration.$description: Colour change on hover and selection.

count-min-size.$description: Count pill: smallest width and height.

count-gap.$description: Space between the label and its count.

count-bg-selected.$description: Count pill fill on the selected tab.

count-text-selected.$description: Count text on the selected tab.

count-bg-alert.$description: Count pill fill while alerts are unhandled.

count-text-alert.$description: Count text while alerts are unhandled.

pill-hit-height.$description: Pill tab tap target. An invisible extension adds the rest.

pill-inner-gap.$description: Space between a pill's label and anything beside it.

card-gap.$description: Space between card tabs. Not given in the spec.

card-count-bg-selected.$description: Count fill on the selected card tab.

card-count-text-selected.$description: Count text on the selected card tab.

vertical-width.$description: Width of the list beside the detail. Not given in the spec.

vertical-gap.$description: Space between list items, and between the list and the detail.

icon.$description: Shared line icon: size and stroke.

stroke-width.$description: Line weight in drawing units. It scales with the icon, so every icon keeps the same proportions.

avatar.$description: Avatar: a person's photo or initials on a tone, with presence dot and group stack.

line-height.$description: Initials line height, so the letters centre exactly.

bg-muted.$description: No name, and offline or not joined.

text-muted.$description: Initials and icon when muted or without a name.

ring-color.$description: Ring around the status dot and between grouped avatars.

dot-xs.$description: Status dot, xs: about a third of the avatar.

dot-sm.$description: Status dot, sm: about a third of the avatar.

dot-md.$description: Status dot, md: about a third of the avatar.

dot-lg.$description: Status dot, lg: about a third of the avatar.

dot-xl.$description: Status dot, xl: about a third of the avatar.

dot-2xl.$description: Status dot, 2xl: about a third of the avatar.

dot-offline.$description: Status dot ring, offline. The dot is hollow.

group-more-bg.$description: The plus count in a group.

focus-color.$description: Focus ring when the avatar is a button.

checkbox.$description: Checkbox: single, group with select all, table row and option card.

radius-sm.$description: Box corners at the small size.

bg-checked-hover.$description: Checked and mixed fill on hover.

mark.$description: Check mark and dash on the fill.

dash-width.$description: Dash for a mixed box, default.

dash-width-sm.$description: Dash for a mixed box, small. Not given in the spec; scaled from the default.

disabled-checked-bg.$description: Unavailable box that is checked: grey fill keeps the value readable.

disabled-checked-mark.$description: Check on an unavailable checked box. The spec does not name it.

gap-md.$description: Space between box and label, default.

gap-sm.$description: Space between box and label, small.

row-min-height.$description: Smallest row height. The label counts as the target.

group-gap.$description: Space between items in a group.

group-legend-gap.$description: Space between the group label and the first item.

card-padding-y.$description: Option card top and bottom padding.

card-gap.$description: Space between box, marker and text in an option card.

text-input.$description: Text input: one-line field with label, icons, suffix, helper and error text.

font-size-lg.$description: Value text, large. Sixteen pixels stops phones zooming in.

border.$description: Resting border, strong enough to meet contrast for controls.

icon-color.$description: Leading icon and clear and show buttons.

focus-ring-width.$description: Ring outside the border. With the border it makes two pixels and adds no layout shift.

error-color.$description: Border, ring and message icon on error.

optional-text.$description: The word optional after the label.

field-gap.$description: Label to field, field to helper text.

action-size.$description: Clear and show button hit area.

action-radius.$description: Clear and show button hover shape.

action-bg-hover.$description: Clear and show button on hover.

toggle.$description: Toggle switch: a setting that is on or off and applies at once.

radius.$description: Track and thumb are fully round.

inset.$description: Space between thumb and track on every side.

disabled-off-ring.$description: Ring around a disabled off track.

disabled-on-bg.$description: Track when disabled and on: grey fill keeps the value readable.

spinner-color.$description: Spinner in the thumb while saving.

state-text.$description: On or Off text beside the switch.

state-line-height.$description: On or Off text line height.

row-gap.$description: Between the label and its description.

easing.$description: Thumb slide and track fade easing.

textarea.$description: Textarea: multi-line field that grows with its text, with count, helper, error and a composer variant.

max-height.$description: Height at eight rows. The field scrolls inside after this.

border.$description: Resting border, strong enough to meet contrast for controls.

focus-ring-width.$description: Ring outside the border. With the border it makes two pixels and adds no layout shift.

error-color.$description: Border, ring and message icon on error.

optional-text.$description: The word optional after the label.

field-gap.$description: Label to field, field to helper text.

icon-gap.$description: Between the helper and the count; between the error icon and its message.

helper-line-height.$description: Helper, error and count line height.

count-over-weight.$description: Character count past the limit is bold.

composer-send-inset.$description: Space between the send button and the composer edge.

composer-send-disabled-bg.$description: Send button while the message is empty.

composer-send-disabled-text.$description: Send icon while the message is empty.
